सैरन्ध्रः,
सैरिन्ध्रः 
__1 A menial servant or attendant. 
__2 A mixed tribe, the offspring of a Dasyu and an Ayogava female; सैरिन्ध्रं वागुरावृत्तिं सूते दस्युरयोगवे [[

सैरन्ध्री,
सैरिन्ध्री 
__1 A maid-servant or female attendant in the women's apartments [a woman of the mixed tribe described in सैरन्ध्र (2)]. 
__2 An independent female artisan working in another person's house. 
__3 An epithet of Draupadī (assumed by her when she acted as servant to Sudeṣṇā, queen of Virāṭa).

a. 
(-की f.) 
__1 Relating to a plough. 
__2 Having furrows. 
-कः 
__1 A plough-ox. 
__2 A ploughman.
__1 A buffalo; अवमानित इव कुलीनो दीर्घं निःश्वसिति सैरिभः [[

.]] 
__2 Indra's heaven or Svarga. 
__3 The sky, atmosphere.

सैरी(रे)यः, सैरी
